name: Progress
description: Progress extends the native HTMLProgressElement properties and wraps the progress bar in a labeled container.

elements.name: label
elements.description: The accessible label for the progress indicator. This prop is required.

elements.name: max
elements.description: The maximum progress value. Defaults to 100.

elements.name: height
elements.description: Sets the progress bar height using a CSS length. Defaults to 7px.

elements.name: hideLabel
elements.description: Hides the visible label while keeping it available through aria-label.

elements.name: dots
elements.description: Adds marked points at numeric positions. Each item accepts a required value, an optional React label, and optional span properties through props.

elements.name: labels
elements.description: Adds evenly distributed React labels from the start to the end of the progress bar. Use either labels or dots, not both.

elements.name: labelProps
elements.description: Passes native label properties to the outer container.

elements.name: dotsProps
elements.description: Passes native div properties to the container holding dots or labels.

elements.name: Native progress properties
elements.description: Other native progress properties such as id, className, and aria-* attributes are forwarded to the progress element.

accessibility.general: The component uses a native progress element and requires a label. Native progress semantics expose the current value and maximum to assistive technologies.
elements: Provide a meaningful label. When hideLabel is enabled, the label is exposed on the outer container through aria-label.
Use dots or labels to provide contextual milestones, but do not rely on their visual position as the only way to communicate progress.
Keep the numeric value within the intended range defined by max so the native progress state remains accurate.
